description:
A LEO spacecraft propagation mission is loaded in GMAT. The spacecraft 'LEO_Sat' orbits at 500 km altitude with 28.5 degree inclination (ISS-like parameters) and propagates for one full day. Currently, the mission has a 3D OrbitView but no ground track visualization.

Your task: add a GroundTrackPlot subscriber to this mission that displays the spacecraft's ground track (its path projected onto Earth's surface). The GroundTrackPlot must include 'LEO_Sat' as a plotted spacecraft. After adding it, run the mission to confirm the ground track renders correctly — you should see a sinusoidal pattern spanning approximately +/- 28.5 degrees latitude.
